description: The national EC interrogation twins FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE-N (ISO 15.29) / EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N (15.31) - the ONLY -N EC twins the 2023 text defines (none exists for EXCEPTION-STATEMENT/-STATUS). LIVE (P10 Step-11 EC-N wave): the base EcFunctions renderings projected national through the ONE NationalOf repertoire translator (15.29.4 r1c / 15.31.3 r2b 'converted at runtime to the runtime national character set'), result category National (Table-16 legality). COBOL-2002 introductions. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985 has no national data (§1985:IV.4.3.3: 'These are grouped into three classes: alphabetic, numeric, and alphanumeric') and its Intrinsic Function amendment's function types are alphanumeric, numeric and integer (§1989:A.2.3: '(1) Alphanumeric functions. These are of the class and category alphanumeric'); §2002:15.24 'The EXCEPTION-FILE-N function returns a national character string that is the I-O status value and file-name of the file connector, if any, associated with the last exception status' ('The type of the function is national.'), §2002:15.26 'The EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N function returns a national character string ...', and §2002:F.2 item 78 'New intrinsic functions are:' lists EXCEPTION-FILE-N and EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N. §2014:15.26 and §2014:15.28 carry both functions. The 2023 delta is only EXCEPTION-FILE-N's optional file-connector argument (§2023:E.3.3 item 26: 'An optional argument has been added to this function to permit the user to specify the file connector for which the information is requested'; staged loud, PHASE-13 Step 9), a change to the argument, not the function's introduction. Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
display: FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE-N / EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N (the national EC twins)
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:15.24 / §2002:15.26, §2002:F.2 item 78); §2023:E.3.3 item 26 is the argument change (VCR rows 68/69)
